correctness.rationale: Exact genotype-marginal survival identities yield (1). Uniform positive stage mixing and selection yield q_i->0 for all initial interior frequencies. For h>0 positive matrix squeezing proves componentwise log rates with strict Perron inequality. For h=0 resistant density evolves exactly with M, normalized susceptible density undergoes a quadratic Perron projection b_{k+1}=b_k-(S/a+o(1))b_k^2; this implies kq_i->1/S and t q_i->tau/S. All assumptions, normalizations and denominators are displayed in RESULT.md and the shipped checker replays.

originality.rationale: Source Theorem 5 provides only qualitative full-resistance convergence. The quantitative dominance phase law and exact reproductive-value-weighted inverse-time coefficient are not direct corollaries of the inspected published statements. Classical unstructured dominant-allele slowing and reproductive-value weights are explicitly acknowledged as prior art. Comparative searches found related but differently parameterized or different-process findings; priority remains literature-bounded with explicit residual risks.
residual_risks: Classical class reproductive-value weighting and quadratic selection-normal-form methods are established prior mathematical principles; future priority investigation may identify a broader second-order theorem implying this special case.
The 2025 helminth drug-resistance study was seen only through abstracts, so possible rate overlap in its full text remains unresolved.
Literature and retrieved mathematical research searches are necessarily non-exhaustive; the general concept of algebraically slow fixation under complete dominance is known.

value.rationale: The source identifies inevitability of resistance but not its velocity; the quantitative time-to-small-susceptibility scale matters for pulsed pesticide management. The stage-specific coefficient measures overlap of treatment selection with ecological reproductive value, and h=0 versus h>0 changes the mathematical convergence class, with a computable Perron exponent. This is a motivated structural asymptotic, not a trivial table or arbitrary numerical slice.
